description: This Dart file defines an AuthController class that manages authentication state in a Flutter application. It handles initialization, sign-in, sign-up, and sign-out processes, persisting login state using shared preferences.

classes.name: AuthController
classes.description: A controller class for managing user authentication state, extending ChangeNotifier to notify UI updates.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the auth controller by loading the login state from persistent storage.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Simulates user sign-in, updates authentication state, and persists login status.

methods.name: signUp
methods.description: Simulates user registration, updates login state, and persists login status.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Signs out the user and clears persisted login state.
